chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi confronts Gu Suizhou about his manipulative behavior, but Gu Suizhou successfully plays the victim, leading Shen to agree to a beach trip. Shen discovers inconsistencies in the medical records of Gu's dog, 'Fluke,' suggesting the dog was acquired much earlier than Gu claimed. Meanwhile, Shen observes Gu Suizhou's aggressive and authoritative demeanor during a high-stakes corporate meeting at W.N company.
